correctness.rationale: A time-three-fixed site has only four allowed histories; checking every birth with exactly two firing Moore neighbors and every permanent resting site against all three phases yields a necessary/sufficient local triple constraint. Closed walks in its complete 4096-pair graph correspond bijectively to labelled time-three returns. Exact SCC decomposition leaves one 184-vertex cyclic graph with 559 edges. Exact symbolic characteristic arithmetic gives x^156Q(x)^2R(x), and the trace–determinant identity yields the stated census for every n>=3; subtract the sole rest fixed point and divide by three. All local edges, SCCs, coefficients, trace values and positive-integer Perron bounds were reconstructed from included files; independently coded C++ exhaustively matches n=3,4,5.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial temporal clock of a canonical refractory cellular automaton is a motivated exact dynamical invariant. The theorem determines all labelled 3-row toroidal primitive-three populations, has a nontrivial sharp onset at circumference four, and provides an explicit rational zeta and rigorously bounded exponential growth constant. These precise period-three counts are not implied by examples or generic transfer existence alone.
